description: List the Windows/OS patches on one device — either those still AVAILABLE (missing) or those already INSTALLED. Takes the device's DeviceGuid (from atera_list_agents / atera_get_agent), not the AgentID. Atera: GET /api/v3/agents/{deviceGuid}/available-patches or /installed-patches.

kind.description: available = patches not yet installed (default); installed = patch history.

name: atera_get_agent_patches
title: Get an agent's patches
